content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Type Erasure and Runtime Type Checks** as part of **Generics and Type-System Design**. On the JVM, generic type arguments are generally erased at runtime; inline reified parameters provide limited type-aware operations within their constraints. Use the subtopics—Generic Type Erasure on the JVM, Limitations of Runtime Type Checks, Reified Type Parameters—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
